title: review: R23: roadmap-status reports the real activation state for allocation, strategy, speculation and Jev points (speculation is off, not active) and regenerates roadmap-status.json
spec:
Why: .orchestrator/roadmap-status.json on goal/T-0561 (generated by orchestrator/roadmap.py, T-0669) lists adaptive-parallelism-p17 (speculation) as implemented_active although pool.toml [speculation].mode = "off", and adaptive-parallelism-p16 (allocation, [allocation].mode = "shadow"), adaptive-parallelism-p18 (strategy, [strategy].mode = "shadow") and phase-i-p7 (Jev decision points, [jev.points].* = "shadow") are not derived from their mode keys either. The brief's completion rule depends on activation state being right: experimental features must show shadow or off.
What (orchestrator/roadmap.py REQUIREMENTS entries and tests/test_roadmap.py; unittest.TestCase methods, import _harness first):
- Give each requirement its mode_key: adaptive-parallelism-p16 -> allocation.mode; adaptive-parallelism-p17 -> speculation.mode; adaptive-parallelism-p18 -> strategy.mode; phase-i-p7 -> jev.points.scout_necessity (representative; document that all four points share the default); phase-i-p5 -> jev.routing.mode; adaptive-parallelism-p15 -> scheduler.jev_mode; adaptive-parallelism-p5/p6/p11/p13 -> scheduler.mode (they apply only when waves are active) if not already so; verify every other mode_key matches the table.key the module reads.
- status(): a mode of "off" yields implemented_off, "shadow" implemented_shadow, "active" implemented_active; unknown or missing value falls back to the module default documented in promotion.FEATURES when the feature is registered there.
- Regenerate .orchestrator/roadmap-status.json with `orchestrator roadmap-status --write` and commit it; complete must remain true.
acceptance: tests/test_roadmap.py::test_experimental_features_report_their_configured_mode — with pool.toml values speculation off, allocation shadow, strategy shadow, jev.points shadow the statuses are implemented_off, implemented_shadow, implemented_shadow, implemented_shadow
tests/test_roadmap.py::test_build_on_repo_marks_goal_complete — still passes and the regenerated .orchestrator/roadmap-status.json has summary.implemented_off >= 1 and complete true

result.summary: Verified against live repo: all mode_key fixes (allocation.mode, speculation.mode, strategy.mode, scheduler.mode on p5/p6/p11/p13, jev.points.scout_necessity on p7) match the actual pool.toml table locations and promotion.FEATURES table/key pairs. Ran tests/test_roadmap.py directly (PYTHONPATH=tests:.) — all 5 tests pass including both acceptance-named tests. status() fallback logic correctly consults promotion.FEATURES only where a feature is registered there; unregistered mode_keys (e.g. jev.points.scout_necessity) fall through to the plain off/shadow/active mapping, which is fine since pool.toml already sets a valid value. Regenerated roadmap-status.json summary counts are internally consistent (29 requirements total, implemented_off=1, complete=true). No blocking issues found.
